projects.title: Arcana SNES Disassembly
projects.status: Published 65c816 assembly disassembly; the README maps the bank files and DiztinGUIsh project but does not state completeness or byte-exact build status.
projects.summary: A bank-organized 65c816 assembly disassembly of the SNES game Arcana. The repository includes the project file and source files for game code, data, graphics, text, and audio banks.
